generate_audio_from_text: generate audio from text prompts using MusicgenForConditionalGeneration.generate with text input
generate_audio_from_audio_prompt: generate audio conditioned on an audio prompt using MusicgenForConditionalGeneration.generate with input_values
build_delay_pattern_mask: build a delayed pattern mask for multi-codebook offset in MusicgenForCausalLM generation
